goal: Remove five friction sources found in the REL-1.106.0 route without weakening any gate: HANDOFF.md out of reviewed diffs, a machine proof that closure records are the only delta after verification, a deterministic adjudication-channel test, one release command that carries installed-proof and live-evidence binding, and a strict-class tier independent of goal wording for non-test scopes (approved by the owner 2026-09-27).

units.criterion: HANDOFF-UNTRACKED-1: HANDOFF.md is no longer tracked by git in this repository (listed in .gitignore, removed from the index) and stays a local hand-over packet; the /handoff skill and the release and ledger-close SCOPE_LOCK templates no longer require HANDOFF.md inside a reviewed diff; the new oracle tests/verify_handoff_untracked.py is RED on the pre-fix tree and GREEN after, and meta_review stays clean.
units.verificationCommand: sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/verify_handoff_untracked.py && sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/meta_review.py

units.criterion: CLOSURE-DELTA-1: a new scripts/itd_closure_delta.py proves that the diff between a verified tree (taken from a receipt) and a later tree touches only closure records - the unit transition in .itd-memory/GOAL.json and STATE.json, appended lines in events.jsonl, the followup move in .itd/ACCEPTANCE_CONTRACT.json, appended entries in .itd/DECISIONS.md and BACKLOG.md - and exits non-zero for any other path or any edit that is not an append; the new oracle tests/verify_closure_delta.py covers accepted deltas and rejected mutations (foreign path, edit in the middle of DECISIONS, a changed unit command leg).

FLAKE-ADJCHAN-1: newest_receipt in tests/verify_adjudication_channel.py selects the receipt deterministically without st_mtime; the new test tests/verify_adjudication_channel_clock.py builds receipts with deliberately inverted mtimes, is RED on the pre-fix helper and GREEN after, and tests/verify_adjudication_channel.py stays green.

INSTALLED-PROOF-HEAD-1: tests/verify_route_debts.py --installed-proof accepts native canary receipts minted in committed-head mode on a clean checkout whose HEAD tree equals the candidate, and still rejects foreign, stale or mismatched receipts; docs/RELEASE_RUNBOOK.md gives a release command template that carries both the installed-proof leg and verify_live_model_benchmark.py --require-evidence and runs on one clean checkout; the new oracle tests/verify_installed_proof_head.py is RED on the pre-fix code and GREEN after, and tests/verify_route_debts.py stays green.
units.verificationCommand: sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/verify_installed_proof_head.py && sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/verify_route_debts.py

units.criterion: TIER-WORDING-2: for scopes that are not tests-only the strict-class tier no longer depends on the wording of the unit goal: synthetic pairs (a template goal vs a detailed description containing a strict word) over the same non-test Allowed Change Areas get one tier, while a strict-class path or keyword inside the Allowed Change Areas still forces high; the new oracle tests/verify_tier_wording.py is RED on the pre-fix matcher and GREEN after, and tests/verify_tier_source.py and tests/verify_risk_tier_default.py stay green.
units.verificationCommand: sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/verify_tier_wording.py && sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/verify_tier_source.py && sh skills/_shared/itd_py.sh tests/verify_risk_tier_default.py
